description:
FamilyOS — a family organizer running fully on OctoMesh.
Dev/test channel variant (mirrors the OneTimeTicket.MainLatest pattern).

Tasks with a points/sticker game, a shopping list, pinboard notes and a
weekly calendar with per-day Mama/Papa assignments. The entire backend is
declarative pipeline YAML executed by the tenant's Mesh Adapter — no
service code.

What this blueprint installs:
- the FamilyOs construction kit model (auto-imported from the catalog)
- a DataFlow with 16 HTTP pipelines hosted by the tenant's Mesh Adapter:
    GET    /state                 aggregated app state for the client boot
    POST   /tasks                 create a task
    POST   /tasks/toggle          toggle + book points server-side
    POST   /tasks/reset           recurrence reset (no scoring)
    DELETE /tasks?id=             delete a task
    POST   /shopping              add an item
    POST   /shopping/toggle       flip an item
    POST   /shopping/clear-done   remove all done items
    DELETE /shopping?id=          remove one item
    POST   /notes                 pin a note
    DELETE /notes?id=             unpin a note
    POST   /days                  upsert a day assignment
    POST   /household/names       save display names
    POST   /household/stickers    persist earned stickers
    POST   /cats/name             rename a calendar category
    POST   /cats/icon             change a category icon
- domain seeds: the Household singleton and three default calendar
  categories
- the FamilyOS web app (React SPA + Node proxy) as an Application workload,
  rolled out to Kubernetes by the Communication Operator as a Helm release,
  pulling the family-os-app chart from the meshmakers-dev Helm repo.

PREREQUISITE: communication must be enabled on the target tenant. The
service-managed System.Communication.MainLatest blueprint seeds the Pool
(670000000000000000000001), Mesh Adapter (670000000000000000000002) and dev
Helm repo (670000000000000000000003) this seed associates to.

Install only seeds entities — trigger the rollout afterwards with
DeployDataFlow (the pipelines) + DeployWorkload (the web app).

NOTE: the staging/production variant is FamilyOs.Release. Keep the
seed-data of the two variants in sync — they differ only in the
Application's HelmRepository association (003 dev vs 005 apps).
